reviews.t: Perfect for sensative skin, or deodorant allergies!
reviews.x: I really like this deodorant for my 14 year old daughter. She has servers reactions to other deodorants (massive sits like pimples on her underarms). She has been using this product for like 4-5 months, and no reactions! She smells pleasant too. I was worried this product wouldn't keep her teenage self being stinky, but it works very well! I dislike that I can only buy 1 at a time. I'd really to get 2 and then order another when she's using her last tube. That way she never runs out.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the deodorant effective at controlling odor and keeping them fresh, even during workouts.
A common complaint is the grainy, clumpy texture that crumbles and doesn't glide on smoothly, requiring rubbing in with fingers.
Several reviewers praise the citrus scent as pleasant and fresh.
Some users report skin irritation, rashes, or burns from the product.
A few reviewers found the deodorant did not last or work for them.
